definitions.explanation: a shop or business that acts as an intermediary between a manufacturer or service provider and the end customer

notes:
Combines ⟦{取次|とりつぎ}→取次：22549_toritsugi⟧ (intermediary, agency) and ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (shop). In the Japanese publishing industry, ⟦{取次|とりつぎ}→取次：22549_toritsugi⟧ specifically refers to the wholesale distributors (such as Tohan and Nippan) that sit between publishers and bookstores. Outside publishing, the term is used more broadly for any authorized dealer or agent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取次店|とりつぎてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧: to go through a dealer
- ⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧{取次店|とりつぎてん}: designated agency
- ⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧{取次店|とりつぎてん}: publishing distributor
- {取次店|とりつぎてん}⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧: agency agreement
